headline: Convert files on your computer
privacy: Your files stay on your computer. Nothing is uploaded to the internet.
modeSwitchLabel: What do you want to convert?
pdfHelp: Each page becomes one image file in a folder you choose.
pdfConvertSuccess: Done! Saved {count} page image(s) in that folder.
pdfConvertFailed: We could not convert this PDF. Try another file, or check that PDF tools are installed.
pdfMissingGhostscript: PDF conversion needs Ghostscript on this computer. Install it, or use the Converte Fácil installer that includes it.
imagesToPdfHelp: Add photos, set the page order, then save one PDF on your computer.
imagesToPdfFailed: We could not create this PDF. Try other photos, or check that the conversion tools are ready.
imagemagickTip: Install ImageMagick, or use the Converte Fácil installer that includes it.
ghostscriptTip: Install Ghostscript for PDF conversion, or use the Converte Fácil installer that includes it.
imagemagickBundledTip: Using the ImageMagick copy shipped with Converte Fácil.
ghostscriptBundledTip: Using the Ghostscript copy shipped with Converte Fácil.
enginesError: Could not check the conversion tools. Try restarting the app.
dropHint: Drop images here, or click to choose files
dropUnsupported: This file type is not supported. Try JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, TIFF, or BMP.
dropSomeUnsupported: Some files were skipped because their type is not supported.
dropNoneAdded: Those files are already in the list.
formatHelp: Choose an output format after adding photos.
convertPartial: Finished with some errors. Check each file below.
convertAllFailed: Could not convert the files. Check each file below.
convertFailed: We could not convert this file. Try another image or a different format.
convertMissingMagick: Image conversion needs ImageMagick on this computer. Install it, or use the Converte Fácil installer that includes it.
convertSpawnFailed: We could not start the conversion tool. Try restarting the app, or reinstall Converte Fácil.
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Try again, or pick a different file.
errorCorruptFile: This file looks damaged or incomplete. Try another copy.
errorUnsupportedCodec: We could not read this file. Try a different format (JPG or PNG often works).
errorFileUnreadable: We could not open this file. Check that it is still on your computer and try again.
errorPermission: We could not save there. Choose a different folder, or check folder permissions.
errorDiskFull: There is not enough free space. Free some disk space and try again.
errorTooLarge: This file is too large to convert right now. Try a smaller file.
errorPdfEncrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Unlock it first, then try again.
errorPdfEmpty: This PDF has no pages we can convert. Try another file.
